selector.rationale: The presence of a well-encapsulated mass in the posterior mediastinum with moderate signal intensity on both T1-weighted and T2-weighted images, along with the absence of compressive symptoms or systemic complaints, supports myelolipoma as the most likely diagnosis.

rejected.label: Neurogenic tumor
rejected.why: Radiographic findings were not typical for neurogenic tumors

rejected.label: Mediastinal mass
rejected.why: Too general, as myelolipoma is a specific type of mediastinal mass

rejected.label: Myelodysplastic syndrome
rejected.why: While related to Refractory cytopenia with multilineage dysplasia, it is not as specific to the findings
